title: Improved Confidence Estimates for Black-Box Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for the safe deployment of large language models (LLMs). Existing methods, from verbalized confidence to ones requiring multiple generations, are often zero-shot and produce scores quantifying uncertainty without the need for labelled data. Nonetheless, in practice one must always evaluate their performance on a dataset of interest before deployment. In this work we show that, by leveraging this dataset, we consistently outperform these existing scores. Specifically, we build simple classifiers that predict LLM response correctness by using these scores and the correctness of similar queries as features. Our method produces minimal computational overhead, making it a cheap and straightforward enhancement for UQ in LLMs for real-world applications.

translated_title: 黑盒大型语言模型的置信度估计改进
translated_abstract: 不确定性量化（UQ）对于大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全部署至关重要。现有方法，从言语化置信度到需要多次生成的方法，通常是零样本的，并产生量化不确定性的分数，无需标记数据。然而，在实践中，部署前必须在感兴趣的数据集上评估其性能。在这项工作中，我们表明，通过利用该数据集，我们始终优于这些现有分数。具体来说，我们构建了简单的分类器，通过使用这些分数和相似查询的正确性作为特征来预测LLM响应的正确性。我们的方法产生最小的计算开销，使其成为现实世界应用中LLM UQ的一种廉价且直接的增强手段。
tldr: 本文提出通过利用部署前的数据集构建简单分类器，结合现有不确定性分数和相似查询正确性作为特征，以低成本显著提升黑盒LLM的置信度估计性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using pre-deployment datasets to build simple classifiers that combine existing uncertainty scores and correctness of similar queries as features, achieving consistent improvements in black-box LLM confidence estimation with minimal computational overhead.
